notes.text: Salary model: split (paga base + contingenza) per ilccnl.it, contingenza frozen at EUR 0.00, terzo elemento 0.00 (confirmed via ilccnl.it for D100, D104, D107). base_salary is the full minimo tabellare. Note: ilccnl.it tabelle show the pre-2000 cohort (e.g. D100 Jan2026=1513.09); post-2000 values (D100 Jan2026=1534.16) are sourced from redigo.info and kitech=286.

Cohort: two salary tables — 'in servizio al 15-07-2000' (pre-2000) and 'in servizio dal 15-07-2000' (post-2000). This file models the post-2000 table. kitech.it CodiceCateg=286 title confirms post-2000 identity; redigo.info column 2 matches (D100 Jan2026=1534.16). Pre-2000 table is ~1.4% lower.
Hourly divisor 164.67 h/month from ilccnl.it (single source). Consistent with 38h/week: 52x38/12=164.67. Daily divisor: 26.
Additional months: 14 — tredicesima (dicembre) + quattordicesima (giugno). Source: ilccnl.it ('quattordici mensilitA').
Tranches: 2025-07-01 (+3%) and 2026-01-01 (+2.2%). Both sourced from redigo.info primary table. No pre-July-2025 salary is modeled; engine returns no result for as_of before 2025-07-01.

Dual-cohort: workers hired by 15-07-2000 have a lower salary table (~1.4% below post-2000) not modeled here. Those workers are a declining cohort (tenure 25+ years); new hires always enter the post-2000 table.

limitation.remediation: Model the lower salary table for workers hired by 15-07-2000 behind a hire-date fact.

notes.text: B128 and B132 each contain two ex-classification sub-levels (B128: ex-4/2 and ex-5/2; B132: ex-4/1 and ex-5/1) sharing the same base salary but with different scatto amounts. Modeled as B128/B128_ex52 and B132/B132_ex51. Plain codes carry the ex-4 (higher) scatto as best-guess; _ex52/_ex51 codes carry the ex-5 (lower) scatto. Mapping is unverifiable from public sources (B128: 47.92 vs 44.44; B132: 50.05 vs 47.73).

limitation.remediation: Verify which ex-classification sub-level carries each scatto amount against the CCNL text.

notes.text: Seniority: 10 scatti total — tier 1: 6 biennali (cadence 24 months), tier 2: 1 dodicennale (cadence 144 months after tier 1 exhausted), tier 3: 3 quadriennali (cadence 48 months). All tiers modeled. Per-scatto amounts for tiers 2-3 assumed equal to tier 1 amounts (no independent source found for higher-tier amounts; best-guess from standard CCNL practice).

limitation.remediation: Source the amounts of the dodicennale and quadriennali scatti and correct tiers 2-3.

notes.text: AQ-category levels (AQ162, AQ164, AQ185, AQ187) are quadri. An indennita di funzione may apply per standard quadri CCNL practice, but the amount could not be confirmed from available public sources; not modeled.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: the AQ levels carry IND_FUNZIONE_QUADRI, 140.00 for 14 months (Art. 78, p. 83 of the FLAI-CGIL text).

notes.text: layer_2 out_of_scope: no apprenticeship data found in available public sources. Full CCNL PDF required.

APPRENTICE INPS RATES: the apprentice rates of the sector (agricoltura) apply the 10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus the 1.61% NASpI, but no source found settles the disoccupazione and CISOA contributions of agricultural apprentices (INPS circ. 43/2026 gives no apprentice rates). The contributions of an apprentice may differ.

limitation.remediation: Source the apprentice rates of agricoltura (an INPS circular or an association table of 2026), mark the apprentice block of contribution/2026/agricoltura.json derived, then remove this note.

reviews.scope: The sick pay and the comporto of the CCNL (work_rules.sickness_rules), read on the signed text.
findings: Art. 98 (pp. 92-93): the whole pay for the first ten months of absence and half of it for the next five, as an integration of the INPS indemnity. The file kept the INPS indemnity alone (0/0) from a secondary summary: corrected to 100% for days 1-300 and 50% to day 450, the comporto paid. The continuation of an illness within three months of the end of the last is not modelled (note).

reviews.scope: The indennità di funzione of the quadri, Art. 78 (p. 83).
findings: Art. 78 (p. 83): 140.00 for 14 months to the quadri; p. 11: the Area Quadri is the parametri 162, 164, 185, 187: levels[AQ*].fixed_allowances[IND_FUNZIONE_QUADRI]. Found by a delegated search, checked again on the PDF text.

reviews.scope: The monthly values of the levels against the primary tables (text layer).
findings: 45 values found verbatim on the cited pages and marked verified; 4 left as they were (derived or not on a text page).

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

location.section: Art. 98 (Infortunio e malattia extraprofessionali)
location.quote: Nei casi di infortunio o di malattia non ascrivibili a causa di servizio, ai dipendenti che abbiano superato il periodo di prova, deve essere garantita, mediante integrazione delle somme a tale titolo corrisposte dagli Istituti previdenziali e assistenziali, l'intera retribuzione per i primi dieci mesi di assenza e la metà di essa per i successivi cinque mesi.

provenance.transformation: Art. 98 c. 1: the whole pay from the first day for 10 months, half of it for the next 5, months of 30 days as the tiers count them: 100% for days 1-300 (carenza included), 50% from the eleventh month (tier), the job kept past the fifteenth month only on request and unpaid, so the comporto paid is 450 days (max_duration_days). One rule for every employee. The file had kept the INPS indemnity alone (0/0) from a secondary summary. Read on 2026-10-31.
provenance.note: Art. 98: 'Qualora entro tre mesi dalla fine di un periodo di malattia se ne verifichi un'altra, l'assenza relativa a quest'ultima malattia viene considerata come prosieguo della prima a tutti gli effetti.' The engine continues an episode only when it is marked as a relapse (relapse_of): a new illness within three months of the end of the last one starts its own 10 + 5 months, paid beyond the CCNL (limitation sickness_cumulation_window). Not modelled: no integration during the probation period ('che abbiano superato il periodo di prova'); the further 12 months the job is kept on request with a favourable prognosis, 'non spettano emolumenti di sorta'.

source_document.title: Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro per i Dipendenti dei Consorzi di Bonifica e di Miglioramento Fondiario, Roma 21 maggio 2025 (FAI-CISL)

location.section: Art. 50 - Festività, chiarimento a verbale; accordo sulle festività soppresse, art. 3
location.quote: Le parti si danno atto che il trattamento economico, previsto dall'art. 5, ultimo comma, ultimo periodo, della legge 27 maggio 1949, n. 260, in favore dei "salariati in misura fissa", nelle ipotesi in cui le ricorrenze della festa nazionale (2 giugno), dell'anniversario della Liberazione (25 aprile), della festa del lavoro (1 maggio), e dell'unità nazionale (4 novembre), cadano di domenica, spetta, oltre che agli operai, anche al personale appartenente [...] [Art. 3] Nei confronti di tutto il personale trova applicazione per le due festività nazionali (2 giugno e 4 novembre) la cui celebrazione è stata spostata, rispettivamente, alla prima domenica di giugno e di novembre, la norma di cui all'art. 1 della legge 31 marzo 1954, n. 90 e successive modifiche che disciplina l'ipotesi di festività nazionale coincidente con la domenica.

provenance.transformation: The civil holidays of L. 260/1949 art. 5 (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) on a Sunday, extended to every category, and 4 November on the first Sunday of November: the monthly pay of the chain over the CCNL absence divisor (26).
provenance.note: 2 June is again a holiday on its own date since L. 336/2000: the moved celebration of art. 3 applies to 4 November only. The religious holidays on a Sunday are not paid apart. 4 October, a holiday from 2026 (L. 151/2025), is not in the list: its Sunday stays open.
